messages:
marta_finance: FYI invoice INV-7789 for PondNet (acct PN-778) failed at settlement — card decline `do_not_honor`. Putting it here to decide next steps.

ryan_payments: `do_not_honor` typically means bank refusal. We have scheduled 2 auto-retries left but I'd hold off until CS checks with the customer.

jess_cs: Reached out to Alex at PondNet just now, they said billing contact is switching cards and asked us not to retry until they confirm new payment details.

sam_ops: Ok pausing retries. Can we offer ACH/wire as an immediate alternative? Also curious if we should temporarily suspend their dev instances until payment clears?

marta_finance: Don't suspend production for a single invoice; send payment options first. Offer ACH or wire, note we can reimburse reasonable incoming fees up to $30 as a courtesy.

ryan_payments: Copy. I'll cancel scheduled retries. @stripe-bot cancel retry for charge ch_7ZxY12

stripe-bot: Scheduled retry attempts canceled for charge `ch_7ZxY12` (triggered by ryan_payments). :white_check_mark:

jess_cs: Sending email template now — includes ACH microdeposit steps and wire instructions. I'll include a note asking for the new card last 4 when they update it.

marta_finance: Please flag the account with `manual_review_payment` so billing automation won't touch it for 10 days.

ryan_payments: Flag applied with 10-day TTL. Added ops ticket FIN-3208 to track reconciliation.

sam_ops: Noted. Also recording this as a `do_not_honor` play in the billing playbook with suggested wording for CS.

jess_cs: Email excerpt I sent:

"Hi Alex — we've paused further card attempts. You can either: 1) Send ACH (allow 2–3 business days) or 2) Wire (same-day). If you want to update the card, reply with the last 4 digits and we'll attempt once you confirm. We can cover up to $30 of incoming bank fees for this one-time issue. Once payment is sent, please attach the bank receipt in reply and we'll post immediately.

ACH details:
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Acct: 1122334455
Routing (ABA): 026009593
Ref: INV-7789

Wire SWIFT: RINFUS44
"

marta_finance: Good. Once funds hit, reconcile under FIN-3208 and mark invoice paid. If they insist on waiving all bank fees permanently, escalate to finance leadership.

ryan_payments: Will add a short note in the internal CS template: if customer requests fee waiver > $30, route to finance-leads.

sam_ops: Closing operational hold here. Will watch OPS dashboard for any webhook retries and suppress automatic billing retries for this acct until FIN-3208 resolves.

marta_finance: Thanks everyone — closing thread, will reopen on payment receipt or if customer escalates.
